grades.label: Grade 1
grades.summary: Hilson's Grade 1 UOI learning path, organized by inquiry units and connected subject practice.

units.label: Unit 1
units.title: Goal Setting
units.centralIdea: Setting goals and taking action empower people to learn and grow.

games.title: Goal Steps Quest
games.description: Choose small actions that help a learner reach a school goal.

games.title: MoveSpell - Magic Hand Edition
games.description: Gesture spelling with CVC and high-frequency words.

games.title: Spelling Bee for IB PYP G1
games.description: Listen, spell, and build fluency with Grade 1 words.

games.title: Pronunciation Studio
games.description: Hear and repeat sounds for early phonics practice.

games.title: Kangaroo Math G1
games.description: Short Grade 1 logic and counting missions.

games.title: Arithmetic Worksheet Generator
games.description: Counting, number bonds, addition, and subtraction practice.

games.title: Pinyin Tone Helper
games.description: Practice pinyin tones with large touch-friendly choices.

units.label: Unit 2
units.title: Community Roles
units.centralIdea: People contribute to their community through their roles and responsibilities.

games.title: Community Helpers Sort
games.description: Match helpers, places, and responsibilities in a community.

games.title: MEET MC WORDS
games.description: Vocabulary categories and word recognition.

games.title: Spelling Bee for IB PYP G1
games.description: Community and responsibility words can be practiced in DIY mode.

games.title: Position Explorer
games.description: Use position words to describe where things are in a shared place.

games.title: 3D Shape Explorer
games.description: Rotate, compare, and name 3D solids used in shared spaces.

games.title: Arithmetic Worksheet Generator
games.description: Place value, ones and tens, and facts up to 20.

games.title: Chinese Practice Print
games.description: Printable Chinese writing practice for home-school routines.

games.title: Radical Spinner
games.description: Spin and combine radicals for Chinese character awareness.

units.label: Unit 3
units.title: Storytelling
units.centralIdea: People use stories to share how they think, feel, and what they value.

games.title: Story Sequencer
games.description: Put beginning, middle, and end cards in order and explain the message.

games.title: Time Train - Before & After
games.description: Practice sequence words that help retell stories in order.

games.title: MoveSpell - Magic Hand Edition
games.description: Build story and feeling words through spelling practice.

games.title: Spelling Bee for IB PYP G1
games.description: Practice story, feeling, and audience vocabulary.

games.title: Arithmetic Worksheet Generator
games.description: Numbers to 100, number lines, and story problems.

games.title: Pinyin Tone Helper
games.description: Tone practice for clear storytelling and oral reading.

units.label: Unit 4
units.title: Living Things
units.centralIdea: Respecting and protecting living things helps them survive and thrive.

games.title: Needs of Living Things
games.description: Give plants and animals what they need and explain why.

games.title: UOI4 Living Things - Eco Detective Mission
games.description: Investigate living/non-living things, needs, and protection choices.

games.title: Story Journey: Pictograph and Tally Adventure
games.description: Collect and read data using pictographs and tally charts.

games.title: Quiz Arcade: Pictograph and Tally Sprint
games.description: Fast data questions about how many, most, and least.

games.title: Spelling Bee for IB PYP G1
games.description: Practice plant, animal, and non-fiction vocabulary.

games.title: Bike Gear Lab
games.description: Observe cause and effect in a simple interactive system.

games.title: Chinese Practice Print
games.description: Write living-things and nature words with printable practice grids.

games.title: Radical Spinner
games.description: Notice radicals that help build meaning in nature-related characters.

units.label: Unit 5
units.title: Patterns and Cycles
units.centralIdea: People adapt their daily life and practices to nature's patterns and cycles.

games.title: Life Cycle Builder
games.description: Arrange nature cycle stages and notice what changes next.

games.title: Day and Night Detectives
games.description: Investigate day/night changes and evidence.

games.title: Moon Phases Flashcards
games.description: Recognize moon phases as a natural cycle.

games.title: Three.js Solar System
games.description: Explore planets, orbits, and repeated movement.

games.title: NEON PLANETS - Particle Engine
games.description: A space and motion extension for observing repeated movement.

games.title: Ultimate Galaxy Engine
games.description: Explore spiral motion and visual patterns in space.

games.title: Crystal Galaxy
games.description: Observe color, light, and repeated particle patterns.

games.title: Milky Way Gesture Control
games.description: Use movement to explore a modeled galaxy scene.

games.title: Hand-Controlled Particle System
games.description: Investigate how input changes a visual system.

games.title: Blue Plasma Orb Interface
games.description: Observe light, color, and motion patterns.

games.title: Stable Hand Particle System
games.description: Gesture-based particle motion extension.

games.title: Random Color Hand Particles
games.description: Experiment with changing color and movement.

games.title: Time Train - Before & After
games.description: Sequence daily routines using before and after.

games.title: Position Explorer
games.description: Use shape and position language in a visual scene.

games.title: Spelling Bee for IB PYP G1
games.description: Practice time, cycle, and nature vocabulary.

games.title: Pinyin Tone Helper
games.description: Practice tones for time, season, and nature-cycle words.

games.title: Chinese Practice Print
games.description: Create handwriting practice for cycle and calendar vocabulary.
